visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A light-brown and white Shiba Inu dog sits upright on a beige fabric sofa, facing the camera directly. A human hand holds a professional grey and black condenser microphone close to the dog's snout. The dog maintains a calm, neutral expression. In the background, a large plush pillow shaped like the same dog's head is visible. (2) The scene cuts to an Asian man with short dark hair wearing a white t-shirt, sitting on the sofa. He is looking upwards while his right index finger is inside his nostril, picking his nose with a distracted expression. The lighting is bright and even across the room. (3) The video cuts back to the Shiba Inu, which now has red cartoon 'anger' vein symbols overlaid on its head. The dog looks toward the man, who is now sitting beside it. Yellow and white text captions are displayed at the top and bottom of the frame. (4) The dog suddenly lunges its upper body and front paw toward the man, delivering several rapid slaps to his face and shoulder. The man laughs, recoils, and raises his hands to protect himself in a playful manner. A dark yellow text overlay appears briefly as the dog completes the action.

It sets up a mock interview with a dog, catches the human 'owner' in an unrefined moment (picking his nose), and concludes with the dog 'punishing' the owner for his behavior, using fast-paced editing and cartoonish sound effects to drive the joke.
